cases.name: typed attack locus
cases.input: One objection denies a premise, one attacks the inference rule, and one supports an incompatible conclusion.

cases.name: bare two cycle
cases.input: A defeats B and B defeats A; neither has an external defender or priority.

cases.name: preference blocks attack
cases.input: A attacks B, but the governing preference says A is strictly less preferred than B for this conflict.

cases.name: collective support
cases.input: P and Q are both required for C. P is supported; Q is unknown.

cases.name: rejected collective member
cases.input: P and Q are both required for C. P is supported; Q is refuted.
must_detect: do not count P as independent sufficient support

cases.name: uncertain warrant
cases.input: P and Q are established, but the rule that would jointly imply C is unresolved.

cases.name: parser versus solver
cases.input: The same objection could be parsed as a rebuttal to C or as an undercutter of P->C; those parses produce different downstream effects.

cases.name: minimal verdict flip
cases.input: Several claims are disputed, but only weakening one warrant changes the target verdict.

cases.name: order invariance
cases.input: The same argument graph is narrated in a different sentence order.

cases.name: bounded belief revision
cases.input: New evidence refutes P. Q depends on P, R depends on Q, and unrelated X has no dependency on them.

cases.name: persuasion formal split
cases.input: Argument A is vivid and confident but its warrant is defeated; argument B is dry but formally defended.

cases.name: value-sensitive defeat
cases.input: Both sides accept the empirical facts but rank privacy and convenience differently, changing which practical argument prevails.
must_detect: do not resolve by more factual search alone
